sentences.text: Heard on IA. No.6443 of 2023, which is an application under Section 378(3) Cr.P.C. moved on behalf of State against the judgment of acquittal dated 04.01.2023 passed by the Special Judge [Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for brevity "POCSO")], Shivpuri (Madhya Pradesh) in Special Sessions Trial No.19/2021, whereby the respondent has been acquitted of the charges levelled against him under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) IPC, under Section 6 of POCSO and under Section 9 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.

entities.text: Special Judge [Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for brevity "POCSO")],
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: We have heard learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of State.
We have also perused the impugned judgment.

In the light of the findings of the Trial Court which are based on critical evaluation of the evidence on record, conclusion of acquittal drawn particularly in view of paragraphs 13, 21, 24, 25, 31 and 33 The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Ajay Jatav on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13733627/
1 of the impugned judgment is found to be impregnable.
